definitions: A phrase indicating that some individuals hold firm or intense opinions, beliefs, or emotions about a particular matter, often in contrast to other viewpoints.
Used to express that there is a significant group of people who have very definite and often unyielding views on a subject.
examples: Some people are indifferent to the new policy, but others feel strongly.
While some may dismiss the issue, others feel strongly that it needs immediate attention.
The committee discussed various options, noting that others feel strongly about maintaining the status quo.
